subject: [PATCH v7 4/5] mm/memcontrol: move memory stock to page counters

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch moves the memory stock from memcg to page counters, allowing for more efficient management of memory usage. The change affects how memory and swap counters interact, potentially causing temporary divergence in their raw values. To maintain compatibility, the patch introduces a new logic to ensure that reclaim doesn't swap when memory fails first, even if memory and swap have equal limits. The patch also removes unused memcg code and preserves existing behaviors for cgroup v2 users. The change sets the stage for future work on introducing additional page counters without breaking the fast path.
